user.title: Heads-up
user.description: Sets up Heads-up. Phones appear by themselves under discovered devices once the Heads-up app is open on the same network. Profiles are made under Configure.

pair.title: Link {name}

error.pair_failed: Linking failed. Keep the app open on the phone and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Heads-up is already set up. Phones are added when they are discovered.
abort.already_configured: This phone is already linked. To link it again, delete its device here first (or tap Unlink in the app, which removes it here too).
abort.other_instance: This phone wants to link with another Home Assistant.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Heads-up app.
abort.cannot_connect: The phone could not be reached. Keep the app open on the phone and try again.

add_profile.title: New profile
add_profile.description: How phones handle a notification sent with this profile.

data.name: Name
data.alarm_stream: Sound even when the phone is silent

data_description.alarm_stream: Plays through the alarm volume, like an alarm clock, so it sounds even when the phone is set to silent.
data_description.ring_minutes: For repeating and full-screen alarms. When nobody answers in time, the alarm snoozes itself. 0 rings until someone answers.
data_description.auto_snoozes: After this many automatic snoozes the alarm stays as a silent "Missed" notification, and Home Assistant gets the event headsup_action with action unanswered.
data_description.repeat: The sound keeps playing until the notification is opened, answered or swiped away (or until "Ring for at most" has passed). Off: it plays once.

profile.title: Change profile
profile.description: Phones get the change right away.

default_profile.title: Default profile
default_profile.description: Used when an automation doesn't name a profile, for example with the notify action.

menu_options.weekly: On set days at a set time

weekly.title: Alarm on set days
weekly.description: Rings on the chosen days at the chosen time. When that time falls in an appointment in the chosen calendars, the alarm moves to a while after the appointment, and past the next one too, until there is free time. The phones keep the times, so the alarm also rings without a connection.

data.name: Name
data.calendars: Move when busy in these calendars
data.after: When busy, ring this long after the appointment

data_description.name: Also the title of the notification.
data_description.phones: Leave empty for all linked phones.
data_description.calendars: Leave empty to always ring at the set time.
data_description.needed: The alarm only rings when no appointment starts within this time.
data_description.latest: Without free time before then, it rings at this time anyway.

calendar.title: Alarm for appointments
calendar.description: Rings for every appointment in the chosen calendars whose title contains the text, or is exactly that text (capitals don't matter). The notification shows the appointment's title. The phones keep the times, so the alarm also rings without a connection.

data_description.name: Only to find the alarm here; the notification shows the appointment's title.
data_description.message: Leave empty to show the appointment's time and place.
data_description.phones: Leave empty for all linked phones.
data_description.offset: A negative number rings after it.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description:
The alarm only rings when all of these are true:

{conditions}

menu_options.cond_start: The appointment starts between two times
menu_options.cond_weekdays: The appointment is on certain days
menu_options.cond_title: The title contains a text, or doesn't
menu_options.cond_day: That day has another appointment, or doesn't
menu_options.cond_state: An entity has a state, or doesn't

cond_day.title: Another appointment that day
cond_day.description: For example, no wake-up alarm on a day with "Holiday" in the family calendar.

cond_state.title: Entity state
cond_state.description: Checked each time Home Assistant works out the alarms (every 15 minutes). A phone without a connection keeps its last list.

household.title: Household subscription
household.description: When one phone has the Household subscription, up to {max} phones on this Home Assistant get unlimited notifications, that phone included. Leave this empty to include the phones that were linked first, or pick the phones here. The phone with the subscription is always included.

error.name_taken: There is already a profile with this name.
error.alarm_name_taken: There is already an alarm with this name.
error.text_required: Fill in the text to look for.

options.day_has: That day has an appointment with "{text}"
options.day_not: That day has no appointment with "{text}"

send.name: Send heads-up
send.description: Sends a notification to Heads-up phones, handled as the profile says.

device_id.name: Phones
device_id.description: Leave empty to send to all linked phones.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of the profile. Empty: the default profile.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Their current state is shown in the notification.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Extra buttons; tapping one fires the event headsup_action with its id.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: A new notification with the same tag replaces the earlier one (and cancels its snooze). Also used by Clear heads-up.

ttl.name: Valid for
ttl.description: Don't show the notification when it arrives later than this.

clear.name: Clear heads-up
clear.description: Removes the notification with this tag from the phones, closes its alarm screen and cancels a snooze.

device_id.name: Phones
device_id.description: Leave empty to clear on all linked phones.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: The tag the notification was sent with.

subscription_required.title: {phone} needs a Heads-up subscription
subscription_required.description:
Home Assistant sent a notification that {phone} did not show. Without a subscription, Heads-up shows 10 free notifications, and only while the phone is at home.

To receive every notification, at home and away, subscribe in the Heads-up app on {phone}, for that Google account or as a household for up to 6 phones. Both start with a free trial.

This message goes away once the subscription is active.

household_full.title: {phone} is not in the household
household_full.description: The Household subscription of {owner} covers up to 6 phones on this Home Assistant, and it is full. {phone} needs its own subscription, or you can choose which phones are in the household under Heads-up, Configure, Household subscription.
